verdict: The SC-M01 is the cheapest rotating-globe box worth taking seriously. It has the three safety systems that matter, it takes ordinary kitchen bags, and it costs a third of a Litter-Robot. The plastics feel it, the motor is the loudest here, and the app does the minimum. For a first automatic box in a one- or two-cat home, that is a defensible set of compromises.
pros: Standard kitchen bags — no consumable lock-in
Three safety systems despite the price
Lowest running cost of any powered box here
bestFor: The lowest possible cost per year
notIdealFor: Buyers who want a mature app

sections.setup: About twenty minutes. The instructions are thin and the drum seats with more force than feels comfortable the first time, but nothing is genuinely difficult. Wi-Fi pairing is 2.4 GHz only.
sections.app: Bare-bones. Cycle control, a fill indicator and a visit counter. No health trends, no per-cat separation. It works, and the connection holds, which at this price is the bar.
sections.odorControl: A sealed drawer and carbon filter with no active deodoriser. Fine for one cat, marginal for two. The drawer gasket is the cheapest-feeling component on the unit.
sections.noise: Around 52 dB at three feet — the loudest box in this index. The motor is audible through a closed door. Do not put this near a bedroom.
sections.cleaning: Better than the price suggests. The globe clears clumps properly with clay and tofu, and the 8 L drawer is respectable. The sifting screen needs more frequent attention than the premium boxes.
sections.safety: Infrared entry, weight sensing and anti-pinch reverse — the same three layers as boxes costing twice as much. Meowant cut costs in materials and software, not in sensors, which is the right order.
sections.consumables: Standard kitchen bags and a filter, around $65 a year. The lowest running cost of any powered box here.
sections.longTermCost: Cheap to buy and cheap to run, which is a rare combination. Over five years it is roughly a third of the Purobot Ultra and comfortably the lowest total cost of any smart box in this index.
